_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Kamu bamain Golf (Pamainan Kartu) - Pamain {player_id}.
Tujuan: Dapatkan skor total paliang randah dalam satu ronde. Jika kolom bagarak samo, maka dijumlahkan sabagai 0.
Nilai Kartu: A=1, 2-10=nilai muko, J/Q=10, K=0

Tindakan (gunakan kurung yang tepat):
- '[draw]' - Mangambiak dari dek
- '[take]' - Mangambiak dari tumpukan buangan
- '[swap X Y]' - Mangganti kartu yang diambiak dengan posisi X (baris) Y (kolom)
- '[discard]' - Mambuang kartu yang diambiak

board.drew:
Kamu mangambiak: {card}
Kini kamu harus [swap X Y] atau [discard]
board.took:
Kamu mangambiak: {card} dari tumpukan buangan
Kamu harus [swap X Y] dengannya (indak buliah dibuang)

options.final_turns: Giliran akhir! Pilihan kamu: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Sanak musti: [swap X Y] (indak dapek mangaluakan kartu dari tumpukan pangaluah)

message.deck_empty: Dek lah kosong! Pado akienyo, patandingan iko salasai.
message.knocked: Pamain {pid} diketok! Satiyok pamain lainnyo mandapek ciek giliran.
message.final_round: Pamain {pid} {reason}! Sasiban pamain lain dapat satu giliran lagi

invalid.wrong_action: Gunakan tindakan kurung satu: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], atau [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Kamu harus partamo [draw], [take], [knock], atau [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Awak indak dapek mangaluakan kartu nan diambiak dari tumpukan pangalangan. awak musti manukarnyo.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Kamu alah mangambiak kartu. Kamu harus [swap X Y] atau [discard] kartu itu
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Awak paralu kartu nan dibuek untuak dituka.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Awak paralu kartu nan dibuek untuak di buang.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisi di luar bateh. Gunakan baris 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Awak indak dapek mangetuk jo kartu nan dibuek. Siapkan giliran awak dulu.
invalid.already_knocked: Ado nan alah maulang ronde iko.
